_comment: Experiments of the 21.10.2026 rerun plan, fixed BEFORE any run. Each entry x each seed = one run (scripts/make_plan.py -> configs/plan.json). 'config' lists only fields that differ from smtcore/config.py defaults (Stack, T = 64, Tf = 8, d 64, K 8, SMT 11k / DMT 5k, BPTT 20k at LR 3e-4). Stop criterion: the step budget; where stop_accuracy > 0 a stage also stops once validation long-answer accuracy >= stop_accuracy (checked every eval_every steps). Checkpoint: lowest validation CE on long answers; best AND last weights are evaluated on the independent stream 901.

experiments.name: mqar_T16N2_smt
experiments.purpose: short MQAR, whole example inside the window: teacher j=0 vs memory before the query (after_pairs, before_query), RNN before / after DMT

experiments.name: mqar_T16N2_teacher_bottleneck
experiments.purpose: teacher with L_dec only through K = 8 memory tokens (counterpart of teacher_full)

experiments.name: mqar_T16N2_teacher_full
experiments.purpose: teacher with L_dec only, decoder reads all encoder outputs (changes number of readable vectors AND read mechanism)

experiments.name: mqar_T16N2_transformer
experiments.purpose: ordinary causal Transformer on the same data

experiments.name: mqar_T16N2_rnn_bptt_full
experiments.purpose: the SMT RNN trained directly with full BPTT

experiments.name: mqar_T32N4_smt
experiments.purpose: as T16N2, longer and more pairs

experiments.name: stack_smt_tf8
experiments.purpose: Stack, short window Tf = 8, no far targets (archived base_window / ablation full) on 3 new seeds

experiments.name: stack_smt_tf8_ctx_far
experiments.purpose: + far targets chosen by the frozen context detector

experiments.name: stack_rnn_bptt_full
experiments.purpose: the same RNN, full BPTT (budget 20k steps, LR 3e-4 = archived diagnostic choice)

experiments.name: stack_smt_tf8_dyn_detach_both
experiments.purpose: ablation: authors' detached SMT (no L_dyn gradient into the encoder) - NEW, not the archived 'detached'
